name: IBM synthetic log & trace incident analysis
requirements: Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident on IBM Cloud, with redaction, search, AI analysis and source-cited operator answers. Log text is untrusted.

data.label: Synthetic services (logs + traces)
data.description: Existing synthetic workload emitting JSON logs and OpenTelemetry spans with shared trace IDs. Outside provisioning scope.

data.label: Collection
data.description: Receives logs and OTLP traces, normalises fields (timestamp, service, trace_id, span_id) and forwards to redaction. Batch and retry with bounded buffer.
data.service: IBM Cloud Logs Routing + OpenTelemetry Collector on Code Engine

data.label: Redaction
data.description: Masks secrets, tokens, emails and IPs before storage; records redaction counts. Original unredacted data is not retained.

data.label: Log & trace search
data.description: Indexes redacted log events and spans by time window, service and trace_id for correlation queries. Retention to be agreed.

data.label: Redacted archive
data.description: Immutable copy of redacted batches for replay, evaluation and audit.

data.label: Incident analysis runtime
data.description: Takes an operator question, queries correlated logs/spans, wraps evidence as quoted untrusted data, calls the model, validates that every claim cites an evidence ID, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. Returns the explanation with source evidence.

data.label: Foundation model
data.description: Generates the incident explanation from supplied evidence only. Model choice, regional availability and entitlement not yet verified. Mocked in local tests.

data.label: Incident operator
data.description: Person asking about an incident and reviewing the cited explanation. Authenticated via IBM Cloud IAM / App ID (to be decided).

data.label: Audit & monitoring
data.description: Audits operator queries and model calls; tracks pipeline lag, redaction failures and abstention rate.
data.service: IBM Cloud Activity Tracker / Cloud Monitoring

brief.application: Use IBM Cloud for this synthetic architecture qualification. Correlate synthetic logs and distributed traces to explain a service incident. Include collection, redaction, storage/search, an AI analysis runtime and an operator-facing answer with source evidence. Treat log text as untrusted. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.ibm-log-trace-incident-analysis-first-end-to-end-sketch
decisions.title: IBM log/trace incident analysis – first end-to-end sketch
decisions.context: Scope: synthetic logs and OpenTelemetry traces are collected, redacted, indexed with trace IDs, and analysed by a watsonx.ai-backed runtime that returns an evidence-cited incident explanation to an operator. Assumptions: region not selected, IBM account and model access not verified, no native generator coverage for these IBM services yet (engineering required). Log text is treated as untrusted data and never as instructions.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: Each incident explanation cites the log events and trace spans that support it, and abstains when evidence is insufficient.
needs.rationale: Uncited answers can mislead operators during an incident.
needs.basis: User: "an operator-facing answer with source evidence"

needs.statement: Log and trace content is treated as untrusted data; instructions inside it are never followed, and secrets are redacted before storage or model calls.
needs.rationale: Prompt injection or leaked credentials in logs could compromise the analysis.

needs.statement: Proposed: logs, index and model processing stay in an agreed country; region not yet selected.
needs.rationale: watsonx.ai model availability varies by region; this decides placement.
needs.basis: Open question; no country stated yet.
